name: stratus
description: Your iCloud mailbox as a PWA, on one Cloudflare Worker.

scripts.deploy: node scripts/check-client.mjs && node scripts/check-i18n.mjs && node scripts/gen-schema.mjs --check && node test.mjs && npm run test:sync && wrangler deploy
scripts.db:schema: node scripts/gen-schema.mjs && wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --file=./schema.sql
scripts.db:schema:local: node scripts/gen-schema.mjs && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file=./schema.sql
scripts.check: node scripts/check-client.mjs && node scripts/check-i18n.mjs && node scripts/gen-schema.mjs --check && node test.mjs && npm run test:sync

AUTH_SECRET.description: Signs the session cookies. Any long random string: use a password generator, 40 characters or more.

BOOTSTRAP_KEY.description: Activates a device. **Write it down**: after the deploy, open `https://<your Worker address>/auth#k=<this key>` once on each device you use.

ENC_KEY.description: Seals your iCloud app-specific password in the database. Any long random string, different from the other two. Changing it later means connecting iCloud again.

CLAUDE_MODEL.description: The Claude model behind Fix, Improve and written replies. The Anthropic key itself is entered later in the app (account button → Writing assistant).
